name: The Left Eye
source:
It's 1926 in New York City...

...and Emile de la Roche is many things to many people.  A French aristocrat, leaving a slew of proposals unanswered in Calais.  A visiting [i]bon vivant[/i], sampling the finest of the Big Apple.  The 'Queen of France', a performer and fleeting star of the pansy scene.

The truth?  Emile de la Roche is an illiterate con artist.

[i]He might not even be French.[/i]

And then Emile meets Alex Warren, a mobster's closeted son exiled from Seattle when family affairs got messy.  Rich, naïve and out of his depth in New York's underworld, it should be easy to rip him off and hop the next train.

And that's precisely what Emile and Jackie, his best friend and fixer, intend to do.

But you know how these stories go, right? 

Our heroes are con artists, thieves, and murderers. They’re Great War deserters and draft dodgers, carrying night terrors and trauma, and they're lying to survive every day.

In an era where prohibition forced the best of high society down into the same underground drinking holes as the lowest of the low, they may rub shoulders with old money or mobsters... but they're always faking it.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3811440/The_Left_Eye/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是1926年的纽约市……

…埃米尔·德拉罗什 (Emile de la Roche) 对很多人来说意义非凡。一位法国贵族，在加莱提出了一系列未得到答复的提议。来访的[i]享受生活[/i]，品尝纽约最好的美食。“法国女王”，三色堇界的表演者和转瞬即逝的明星。

真相？埃米尔·德拉罗什（Emile de la Roche）是一位文盲骗子。

[i]他甚至可能不是法国人。[/i]

然后埃米尔遇到了亚历克斯·沃伦（Alex Warren），他是一名黑帮未出柜的儿子，因家庭事务变得混乱而被从西雅图流放。富有、天真，而且超出了他在纽约黑社会的深度，应该很容易欺骗他并跳下一趟火车。

这正是埃米尔和他最好的朋友兼调解人杰基打算做的。

但你知道这些故事是怎么发展的，对吗？

我们的英雄是骗子、小偷和杀人犯。他们是一战逃兵和逃兵者，患有夜惊症和创伤，每天都在撒谎以求生存。

在一个禁酒令迫使上流社会最优秀的人与下层社会中最底层的人一起进入地下饮酒场所的时代，他们可能会与老钱或黑帮擦肩而过……但他们总是假装如此。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3811440/The_Left_Eye/]Steam[/url]]
